design.solver: Jacobi PCG, f64 iterates and accumulation, four-lane tile
design.residual: max interior abs((rhs-Aphi)/diag(A)), kT/e; separately checked after float32 storage
design.reference: independent unpreconditioned JAX SciPy CG; separately written sliced interior stencil, L2 rtol=1e-13 atol=1e-12, true residual <=1e-10
design.reference_adapter_note: The reference arm borrows converged PBConfig for setup/post and inherits its diagnostic field names; the actual solve is the independent REF.pool implementation, with the separately stated reference tolerances.
design.storage: Reference and production solve the physical float32 setup diagonal in f64. Both use original f32 focusing/postprocessing. Delphi keeps its rounded reciprocal and stopped iterate unchanged.

memory.scope: actual API.run, fake PB/MC, real assembly/shards/resume bookkeeping; input plan preallocated; numeric timing rows retained, nonnumeric 32KiB field filtered

limitations: Historical data-driven M1/M2/M5/M6/determinism scripts were not rerun verbatim; M7 baseline/repeat/fresh/teacher gates re-execute their relevant production paths on the required sets.
Tight discrete convergence is not continuum or experimental accuracy.
Full reference chaining retains the existing f32 focusing/postprocessing.
MC errors include sampling effects; CRN and seed-noise references are reported.
Fresh-process determinism covers bench20 for both modes on A40 and default mode on CPU; the full104 A40 sets are repeated in one process.
No GH200 or 30k-state production run in M7.
